lower_tail_caveat: Ridge improves MAE/top10 and positive r, but lower-tail global MAE is worse than S1A; promising_S1 is not a thin-tail or stability claim.
selection_basis: both schemes: MAE<S1A, positive Pearson r not worse than S1A, global top10 recall not worse than S1A; affine preferred when Ridge does not strictly dominate on both schemes
